title: Syrian-Style Lamb Kebabs
description: Tender lamb skewers marinated in a blend of Middle Eastern spices, perfect for a flavorful dinner experience.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Syrian spice blend, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the marinade and mix until they are well coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they are cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the kebabs to a serving platter and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, salad, or couscous.
